notes.title: Ver1.0.16 released
notes.content:
I updated to unity2019.4.12f1
This fixed a memory leak during loading a scene which has lots of references of textures.
And so this fixed freeze bug during loading apartment scene from title.

notes.title: trouble shooting
notes.content:
[h2]Freeze while loading after clicking new game[/h2]
Unity's bug.
Lower spec of gpu, easier to appear.
I sent a bug report 4 months ago, it will be fixed soon.
[url=https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/addressables-cause-a-leak-when-loading-a-scene-with-addressables-dot-loadsceneasync-which-has-more-than-40-texture-references]https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/addressables-cause-a-leak-when-loading-a-scene-with-addressables-dot-loadsceneasync-which-has-more-than-40-texture-references[/url]


[h2]App is crashed[/h2]
If you use Intel HD graphics, It is easy to appear.
Please try to update latest graphics driver.
Even if update but continue to crash, Sorry, you can not play this game.
I expect a better video card ( gt 1030 over
